# Neptune Filtration

> Whole home water filtration, supplied and installed across Melbourne, Victoria, and only in Melbourne. A 5-stage, 3-filter system, WaterMark certified, installed by a licensed plumbing team. Nobody comes to your home: we plan the set-up from your photos and give you your exact price on a quick Zoom.

## Key facts

- Cost: whole home water filtration in Melbourne usually costs $3,000 to $5,000 installed. Neptune gives an exact price for each home on a quick Zoom, with 20% off when you go ahead at your appointment. Interest-free payment options are available, subject to approval.
- System: 20-inch system with full pressure at every tap. 3 filters, 5 stages: sediment (pleated polypropylene, 5 micron), limescale (carbon block with polyphosphate, 1 micron), chlorine and chloramine (activated coconut shell carbon block, 1 micron), and heavy metals from older pipes. Stainless steel cover, copper piping, bypass valve, water connection only (no power, no gas).
- Filters: changed about once a year in most Melbourne homes. A new set is $300, delivered with GST included; customers swap them with a video guide.
- Install: about 5 days on average from booking to install; 2 to 3 hours on the day.
- Backing: WaterMark certified, licensed plumbing team, 7-year workmanship warranty, 30-day money-back guarantee.
- Service area: right across Melbourne. Whole home filtration only.
- Contact: 0468 018 396, office@neptunefiltration.com.au. ABN 30 695 743 849.
